question: Should acknowledge, supersede, and decision-mark operations on persisted durable wakes become permanent public CLI and `operator.write` Gateway APIs?
rationale: Tests and live output can prove the mechanics, but they cannot decide the long-term authorization, compatibility, and product ownership contract for mutating durable owner-attention state.

options.title: Approve bounded public controls
options.body: Sponsor the three write APIs, require the package build to pass, and review the full stacked upgrade and delivery lifecycle before landing.

options.title: Ship read-only inspection first
options.body: Keep list, inspect, attempts, coordination, and obligations surfaces while deferring mutation APIs to an owner-approved workflow.

options.title: Pause the control slice
options.body: Do not land this PR until the prerequisite durable foundations and downstream handoff establish a complete supported lifecycle.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded public controls
recommendation.body: Sponsor the three write APIs, require the package build to pass, and review the full stacked upgrade and delivery lifecycle before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-level product and Gateway contract choice rather than a mechanical code repair.
